title: ReAPO: Retry-Aware Policy Optimization for Efficient Exploration in LLM Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.28770v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: RLVR improves language-model reasoning, but commonly relies on independent stochastic rollouts for exploration, which can repeatedly sample similar failed strategies. Prior work has seen success with approaches that guide exploration by introducing dependence into the sampling process by including incorrect solutions in the context for subsequent attempts. Still, these methods introduce the additional question of how to assign credit to each attempt. We propose to view the credit assignment through the lens of Stochastic Shortest Paths, a framework in classical reinforcement learning that seeks to minimize the expected cumulative cost to reach a terminal state (in our case, a verified successful response). We show that, under suitable simplifying assumptions, this perspective naturally leads to a simple modification to GRPO, which we call Retry-Aware Policy Optimization (ReAPO). translated_title: ReAPO：面向大语言模型推理高效探索的重试感知策略优化
translated_abstract: RLVR（可验证奖励强化学习）提升了语言模型的推理能力，但其探索通常依赖独立的随机采样，这会导致反复采样到相似的失败策略。已有工作通过在后续尝试的上下文中包含错误解法，在采样过程中引入依赖关系来引导探索，并取得了成功。然而，这类方法引入了一个额外的问题：如何为每次尝试分配信用。我们提出从随机最短路径的视角来审视信用分配问题——这是经典强化学习中的一个框架，旨在最小化到达终止状态（在我们的场景中即经过验证的成功回答）的期望累积成本。我们证明，在适当的简化假设下，这一视角自然地引出了对 GRPO 的一个简单修改，我们称之为重试感知策略优化。ReAPO 会为失败的轨迹分配额外的生成资源……
tldr: 提出基于随机最短路径框架的信用分配方法 ReAPO，通过为失败轨迹分配额外生成预算来实现重试感知的策略优化，从而提升大语言模型推理中探索的效率。
en_tdlr: Proposing ReAPO (Retry-Aware Policy Optimization), which leverages the Stochastic Shortest Paths framework for credit assignment across retries and allocates additional generation budget to failed trajectories, enabling efficient exploration in LLM reasoning.
